desc:
Collect packs, open them at your base and build the best card collection!

HOW TO PLAY
- Run down the hallway and grab card packs from each area
- Watch out for the bosses: they will chase you, so get back to your base fast
- Place your packs at your base and open them to discover new cards
- Show your best cards in your collection and earn money every second
- Upgrade your treadmill to get faster and reach better areas

FEATURES
- 6 areas with unique cards and special rare packs
- Card grading: get your cards rated and see their final score
- Contours and mutations: Silver, Gold, Rainbow and more
- The Flying Dutchman event: a ghost ship brings special packs at night
- Rebirths, trails and the full card index to complete

Join our community for a special in-game reward!

Have fun and good luck on your next pack!
